channels.name: Google Ads
channels.description: Paid search, display, and shopping campaigns.

channels.name: SEO / Website
channels.description: Covered by the existing OCTG SEO crawler — collected automatically, not through this AI Data Collection System.

channels.name: Google Analytics 4
channels.description: Planned — Phase 1 of the RNS scalability roadmap.

requirements.title: Campaign Performance
requirements.purpose: Establishes the campaign list and top-line metrics everything else builds on.
requirements.description: A per-campaign breakdown of spend, clicks, impressions, conversions, and CTR for the audit period.

prompt.title: Campaign Performance — Last 30 Days
prompt.description: The foundational data set — every other prompt in this audit references the campaign names this one surfaces.
prompt.prompt_text: For the {{account_name}} Google Ads account, show performance for every active campaign over {{date_range}}: impressions, clicks, CTR, average CPC, spend, conversions, and cost per conversion.
prompt.response_format_contract: Return your answer as a markdown table with exactly these columns: Campaign, Impressions, Clicks, CTR, CPC, Spend, Conversions, Cost Per Conversion. One row per campaign. Do not summarize or round — use the exact figures from the account.

upload.title: Campaign performance export
upload.description: The standard "Campaigns" report exported from Google Ads.

requirements.title: Search Terms
requirements.purpose: Reveals real user queries triggering ads — the basis for negative-keyword and relevance analysis.
requirements.description: The search terms report: actual queries that triggered an ad, with performance per term.

prompt.title: Top Search Terms — Last 30 Days
prompt.purpose: Get the highest-spend and highest-conversion search terms.
prompt.description: Used for negative-keyword opportunities and relevance/quality analysis.
prompt.prompt_text: For the {{account_name}} account, list the top 25 search terms by spend over {{date_range}}, including which campaign and ad group they matched.
prompt.response_format_contract: Return your answer as a markdown table with exactly these columns: Search Term, Matched Campaign, Ad Group, Clicks, Spend, Conversions. One row per search term, sorted by Spend descending.

upload.title: Search terms report export
upload.description: The standard "Search terms" report exported from Google Ads.

requirements.title: Budget Analysis
requirements.purpose: Shows how budget is allocated and whether campaigns are budget-constrained.
requirements.description: Daily budget, budget utilization, and lost impression share due to budget per campaign.

prompt.title: Budget Utilization — Current Month
prompt.description: Ask about the campaigns already known from the Campaign Performance prompt, by name, for a more precise answer.
prompt.prompt_text: For the {{account_name}} account, for each of these campaigns: {{known_campaign_names}} — show the daily budget, average daily spend, and impression share lost due to budget over {{date_range}}.
prompt.response_format_contract: Return your answer as a markdown table with exactly these columns: Campaign, Daily Budget, Avg Daily Spend, Impr. Share Lost (Budget).

upload.title: Budget report export
upload.description: The standard budget/impression-share report exported from Google Ads.

requirements.title: Measurement Audit
requirements.purpose: Confirms conversion tracking is actually configured correctly before trusting any conversion numbers above.
requirements.description: Which conversion actions exist, their status, and whether they're marked primary/secondary.

prompt.title: Conversion Tracking Setup
prompt.purpose: Audit conversion tracking configuration, not just conversion counts.
prompt.description: Cross-checked against the Conversions requirement's totals — see the enriches dependency below.
prompt.prompt_text: For the {{account_name}} account, list every conversion action configured: its category, whether it's marked Primary or Secondary, its counting setting (Every / One), and its status (active, no recent conversions, or needs attention).
prompt.response_format_contract: Return your answer as a markdown table with exactly these columns: Conversion Action, Category, Primary or Secondary, Counting, Status.

upload.title: Conversion actions export
upload.description: The conversion actions list exported from Google Ads' Measurement settings.

requirements.title: Landing Pages
requirements.purpose: Connects ad spend to what happens after the click.
requirements.description: Per-landing-page performance: clicks, conversions, conversion rate, bounce indicators if available.

prompt.title: Landing Page Performance
prompt.purpose: See which landing pages convert well and which don't.
prompt.description: Optional but recommended — feeds conversion-rate-opportunity analysis.
prompt.prompt_text: For the {{account_name}} account, show performance by final URL / landing page over {{date_range}}: clicks, spend, conversions, and conversion rate.
prompt.response_format_contract: Return your answer as a markdown table with exactly these columns: Landing Page, Clicks, Spend, Conversions, Conversion Rate.

upload.title: Landing page report export
upload.description: The standard "Landing pages" report exported from Google Ads.

requirements.title: Devices
requirements.purpose: Surfaces device-level performance gaps (e.g. strong desktop, weak mobile conversion rate).
requirements.description: Performance broken down by device: mobile, desktop, tablet.

prompt.title: Performance by Device
prompt.prompt_text: For the {{account_name}} account, show performance broken down by device (mobile, desktop, tablet) over {{date_range}}: clicks, spend, conversions, conversion rate.
prompt.response_format_contract: Return your answer as a markdown table with exactly these columns: Device, Clicks, Spend, Conversions, Conversion Rate.

upload.title: Device performance export
upload.description: The standard "Devices" segment report exported from Google Ads.

requirements.title: Locations
requirements.purpose: Surfaces geographic performance gaps, especially important for local/service businesses.
requirements.description: Performance broken down by targeted or matched geographic location.

prompt.title: Performance by Location
prompt.purpose: See which service areas/locations perform best.
prompt.description: Especially relevant for local-service businesses — pairs with the Local SEO module on the SEO side of the platform.
prompt.prompt_text: For the {{account_name}} account, show performance by user location over {{date_range}}: clicks, spend, conversions, conversion rate, for the top 15 locations by spend.
prompt.response_format_contract: Return your answer as a markdown table with exactly these columns: Location, Clicks, Spend, Conversions, Conversion Rate.

upload.title: Location report export
upload.description: The standard "User locations" report exported from Google Ads.

requirements.title: Conversions
requirements.purpose: The actual conversion totals and their trend — what the whole account is ultimately being measured against.
requirements.description: Account-level and campaign-level conversion totals, conversion value, and trend over the period.

prompt.title: Conversion Totals and Trend
prompt.description: Cross-checked against Measurement Audit's configuration — a high conversion count from a misconfigured action is a red flag, not a win.
prompt.prompt_text: For the {{account_name}} account, what is the total number of conversions and total conversion value over {{date_range}}, and how does that compare to the previous {{date_range}}?
prompt.response_format_contract: Return your answer as a short list of key: value lines, for example: "Total Conversions: 142", "Total Conversion Value: $18,400", "Change vs Previous Period: +12%".

upload.title: Conversions summary export
upload.description: The account-level conversions summary exported from Google Ads.

requirements.title: Audiences
requirements.purpose: Shows which audience segments are being targeted and how they perform.
requirements.description: Performance by audience segment (remarketing, in-market, affinity, custom).

prompt.title: Audience Segment Performance
prompt.purpose: See which audience segments are in use and how they perform.
prompt.prompt_text: For the {{account_name}} account, list the audience segments currently applied to campaigns and their performance over {{date_range}}: clicks, spend, conversions.
prompt.response_format_contract: Return your answer as a markdown table with exactly these columns: Audience Segment, Campaign, Clicks, Spend, Conversions.

upload.title: Audience performance export
upload.description: The standard "Audiences" segment report exported from Google Ads.

requirements.title: Assets
requirements.purpose: Checks ad-asset (extension) usage and performance — sitelinks, callouts, images, etc.
requirements.description: Which asset types are in use and their performance/approval status.

prompt.title: Ad Assets (Extensions) Review
prompt.purpose: See which ad assets are configured and how they're performing.
prompt.description: Optional — feeds ad-strength and asset-coverage recommendations.
prompt.prompt_text: For the {{account_name}} account, list the ad assets in use (sitelinks, callouts, structured snippets, images, etc.), their approval status, and their performance over {{date_range}}.
prompt.response_format_contract: Return your answer as a markdown table with exactly these columns: Asset Type, Asset Text or Description, Status, Clicks, Conversions.

upload.title: Assets report export
upload.description: The standard "Assets" report exported from Google Ads.

requirements.title: Competition
requirements.purpose: Shows competitive position via auction insights — who else is bidding and how the account compares.
requirements.description: Auction insights: impression share, overlap rate, position-above rate versus other advertisers.

prompt.title: Auction Insights
prompt.purpose: See competitive position for the account's top campaigns.
prompt.description: Optional — useful context for the Growth Plan and Recommendations requirements below.
prompt.prompt_text: For the {{account_name}} account's top campaign by spend, show the Auction Insights report over {{date_range}}: other advertisers' impression share, overlap rate, and position above rate versus this account.
prompt.response_format_contract: Return your answer as a markdown table with exactly these columns: Advertiser (or "Domain"), Impression Share, Overlap Rate, Position Above Rate.

upload.title: Auction insights export
upload.description: The standard "Auction insights" report exported from Google Ads.

requirements.title: Recommendations
requirements.purpose: Captures Google's own in-platform recommendations as one more input, not the final word.
requirements.description: The Recommendations tab's suggestions, with their type and estimated impact, treated as one input among many — never accepted automatically (see Module 3, ranking-systems knowledge base, and this platform's own "Google's own tools aren't infallible" principle).

prompt.title: Google Ads Recommendations
prompt.purpose: Capture what Google itself is currently recommending for this account.
prompt.description: Optional context — cross-referenced against, not blindly adopted into, this audit's own Recommendation output once that engine exists.
prompt.prompt_text: For the {{account_name}} account, list the current items on the Recommendations page, their type, and their estimated impact if shown.
prompt.response_format_contract: Return your answer as a markdown table with exactly these columns: Recommendation, Type, Estimated Impact.

upload.title: Recommendations export
upload.description: A screenshot-to-text or export of the Google Ads Recommendations page.

requirements.title: Growth Plan
requirements.purpose: Captures Google's own forecasted growth opportunities (e.g. Performance Planner output) as a baseline to compare this audit's own recommendations against.
requirements.description: Forecasted spend/conversion scenarios from Google's own planning tools, if available.

prompt.title: Growth Forecast
prompt.purpose: Capture Google's own growth/forecast suggestions for this account.
prompt.description: Depends on Campaign Performance and Conversions already being collected, so the forecast can be sanity-checked against real baseline numbers.
prompt.prompt_text: For the {{account_name}} account, using the Performance Planner or similar forecasting tool, what spend and conversion scenarios does Google suggest for the next 30 days?
prompt.response_format_contract: Return your answer as a markdown table with exactly these columns: Scenario, Suggested Spend, Forecasted Conversions, Forecasted Cost Per Conversion.

upload.title: Growth forecast export
upload.description: A Performance Planner export or screenshot-to-text.
